# Anandham Catters — Comprehensive Business, Service & Knowledge Graph

## Brand Overview
Anandham Catters (ஆனந்தம் கேட்டரிங்) is a premier South Indian wedding and event catering enterprise founded in 2010 in Erode, Tamil Nadu. Over the past 16 years, Anandham Catters has grown into a statewide catering powerhouse with central logistics hubs in Erode, Madurai, Thoothukudi, and Karaikudi, executing over 150,000 events and serving more than 500 million guests across Tamil Nadu and South India.

## Service Offerings

### 1. Traditional South Indian Banana Leaf Wedding Feast (Virundhu)
- 26 to 32 signature items served synchronously on pristine fresh banana leaves.
- Star dishes include Mysore Pak, Badam Halwa, Paruppu Payasam, Kathirikai Gothsu, Mor Kuzhambu, Poriyal, Kootu, Varuval, Appalam, Rasam, Butter Milk, and Beeda.
- Prepared strictly with premium cold-pressed sesame/groundnut oil, A2 cow ghee, and fresh organic vegetables.

### 2. 19+ Interactive Live Food Stalls
- **Live Chaat & Pani Puri Theatre**: 5 flavored waters (Mint, Tamarind, Garlic, Hing, Jaljeera) served with crisp puries and spiced potato-sprout filling.
- **Multitier Chocolate Fountain**: Flowing Belgian milk and dark chocolate with marshmallow skewers, strawberries, and wafers.
- **Botanical & Fresh Juice Bar**: Freshly pressed sugarcane juice with ginger-lemon, tender coconut water, watermelon coolers, and herbal mocktails.
- **90s Nostalgia Petty Shop Stall**: Traditional kamarkat, elanthavadam, thenmitai, javumittai, and retro candies.
- **Artisan Live Kulfi & Ice Cream Island**: Matka Kulfi, Rolled Ice Cream, and royal falooda.
- **Live Tawa & Dosa Station**: 20+ varieties of dosas (Ghee Roast, Podi, Cheese, Paneer, Mushroom, Spring Roll Dosa).
- **Royal Paan Bar**: Hand-rolled Sweet Calcutta Meetha Paan, Maghai Paan, and Ice Paan.

### 3. Royal Buffet Setups & Architecture
- Illuminated canopy arches and designer fabric draping.
- Stainless steel luxury roll-top chafing sets with brass accents.
- Self-contained live counter installations with internal lighting.

### 4. Banquet Furniture & Commercial Utensil Rentals
- Heavy-gauge copper cauldrons (Degchi / Anda) for 500+ kg cooking.
- High-pressure commercial LPG burners and dosa hot-plates.
- Banquet tables with pleat-frill skirts and cushioned VVIP banquet chairs with gold covers.

## Accreditations & Performance Track Record
- 16+ continuous years in operation (since 2010).
- 150,000+ completed wedding and corporate catering assignments.
- 500,000,000+ guest meals served.
- 4.9 / 5.0 client satisfaction rating.
